# unco_variable_entry_patch (Resource)

Applies an RFC 7396 JSON merge-patch at apply time to an existing JSON-valued Unco variable entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unco_variable_entry_patch" "example" {
  warehouse  = "sample-warehouse"
  set_id     = "acc-sandbox"
  name       = "config"
  patch_json = jsonencode({ id = "123456789012" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `patch_json` (String) RFC 7396 JSON merge-patch object to merge into the existing variable entry value.
- `set_id` (String)
- `warehouse` (String)

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value pairs that re-apply the patch when changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (Number) Resulting variable set version after applying the patch.
